question: In a certain code language, SNAKE is coded as 15. How will DONATION be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ea82bd5c97415b6a0bb4a31c9208d4af49dfee9c43ef8ee84e3fd4a2b56e847.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Number of the letter in the word × 3 = Code of the word.**

 
• SNAKE is a **5** letter word.
 
• It is coded as 15 i.e. **5 × 3.**

Similarly, 

 
• DONATION is an** 8** letter word.
 
• So, it will be coded as **8 × 3 = 24.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "24".**
